{"notes":"Also in S5 scope: replace the TEMPORARY external_senders walker in hub/room.rs with Observer::external_senders() (M2), and add the H11 check (wire::GroupInfo::has_ratchet_tree_extension) in create_room as well as on /update. Start after S7 lands (both touch store/log.rs and hub/mod.rs).
From S6: enqueue_fanout runs on the pool, not in a transaction; S5 (and S7's store/log.rs) needs a transactional enqueue variant writing log + outbox in one tx, then FanoutHandle::wake().
From S7: reuse/share submit.rs's private room_state(&Observer) helper; update stub row in hub_foundation (501) and http.rs in-handler 400 mapping need the same treatment; wake FanoutHandle after commit (Hub has no handle yet — add in S5 or S10).
2026-10-18 S5 agent BLOCKED before code: mimi-mls ProposalDetail/ProposalKind::AppDataUpdate carries only component_id, no op (update/remove) or update bytes. authorize_proposal needs AppDataOp::Update(bytes) for participant_list/roles/preauth/base_room_policy proposals, so the proposal arm cannot be built without a new mimi-mls API (proposed M3: ProposalKind::AppDataUpdate { component_id, update: Option<Vec<u8>> } (None = remove), filled for process_proposal and pending_commit_detail). Also needs a decision: hub apply semantics for non-hub-tracked components (proposed: room_metadata/franking_agent strict-decode full replacement; any other component invalid per mls-extensions-10 §4.7)."}
